outline: 1388 Mental Shortcuts for Adding and Subtracting Integers

examples.solution_text:
(a) Split $57$ as $23+34$ to make a zero pair.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}23-57\\&=23-23-34\\&=-34\end{aligned}$

(b) Split $71$ as $46+25$ to make a zero pair.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-46+71\\&=-46+46+25\\&=25\end{aligned}$

(c) Add the magnitudes and keep the minus sign.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-38+(-17)\\&=-38-17\\&=-(38+17)\\&=-55\end{aligned}$

Rewrite the touching signs, then work from left to right.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-12+(-5)-(-9)-(+7)\\&=-12-5+9-7\\&=-17+9-7\\&=-8-7\\&=-15\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
Rewrite with a single plus or minus symbol, then calculate.
(a) $7+(+6)$
(b) $10-(+3)$
examples.solution_text:
(a) Adding a positive integer moves right.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}7+(+6)\\&=7+6\\&=13\end{aligned}$

(b) Subtracting a positive integer moves left.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}10-(+3)\\&=10-3\\&=7\end{aligned}$
